sources.refreshNotes: Primary reproducible statistical backbone. nflverse documents raw play-by-play arriving roughly 1–2 hours after games, processed PBP/player stats updating daily in season, rosters daily, snap counts/advanced stats polled multiple times daily, and Next Gen Stats daily.
Final provider selection should favor timestamped multi-book data. Public cross-checks can bootstrap the portal, but an API/feed is preferable for automated historical snapshots.

modelingRule: Store source/raw fields separately from derived model features. Derived EPA, success rate, opponent adjustments, rolling windows and player/unit values should be reproducible from versioned source snapshots whenever possible.
